questions.text: Mohan withdrew Rs. 5,000 at the beginning of every month during the year. Interest on drawings is charged @ 15% p.a. The interest on Mohan's drawings for the year is:
questions.explanation: total drawings = Rs. 60,000; average-period method, drawn at the beginning IOD = Rs. 4,875  Correct option A. Distractors: B = used the end-of-period average period (timing trap); C = used 6 months average regardless of timing; D = charged a flat rate with no time factor.
